# Charades GO

> Charades GO: The FREE family party game. Charades GO is a free charades app for iPhone (also on iPad) by David Baez. Hold the phone to your forehead, your friends and family shout clues, tilt down when you guess it and tilt up to pass. The whole game and every deck are free to play.

## Key facts

- Name: Charades GO
- Tagline: Charades GO: The FREE family party game
- Platform: iOS (iPhone and iPad), free download on the App Store
- Price: free. The whole game and all 60+ themed decks are free to play. Charades GO+ is an optional extra that removes ads and unlocks longer round timers.
- Players: 2 to 100+ (a local multiplayer, pass-the-phone game)
- Ages: all ages, rated 4+, with decks made for young kids
- Works offline
- Decks: 60+, including Everything, Made for Kids, Emoji, Act It Out, Hum That Tune, Bedtime Stories, Animalistic, Fast Food, Accents and Christmas decks. New decks are added regularly.
- Publisher and developer: David Baez
- App Store rating: 4.7 out of 5 from 716 ratings (checked on the US App Store page, November 2026)
